title: A Kinetic Theory Approach To Ordered Fluids: Direct Simulation Monte Carlo Methods
summary: We present a direct simulation Monte Carlo (DSMC) method for the kinetic theory of ordered fluids recently introduced by the authors. The microscopic constituents of these fluids carry an order parameter belonging to a manifold. The method applies Strang splitting to couple a Monte Carlo treatment of the binary collisions with a symplectic integration of the mean-field Vlasov transport on the order-parameter manifold.
